How-to Videos
AGS-V is a user-friendly testing machine that allows anyone to easily and safely measure material strength.
 The Procedure for Material Testing Using AGS-V
AGS-V is a user-friendly testing machine that allows anyone to easily and safely measure material strength.
Creation of Test Conditions by the Operation Controller
The AGS-V is equipped with a highly visible color LCD panel. Test conditions can be set smoothly by following the on-screen instructions. The interface is intuitive and user-friendly for anyone.
 Elimination of Initial Load by Specimen Protection
The AGS-V is equipped with a specimen protection function on the handheld operation controller. During specimen mounting, the applied test force can be automatically released with a single touch. This allows anyone to easily obtain accurate data.
 Intelligent Crosshead
The AGS-V is equipped with an intelligent crosshead function that combines convenience and safety. By simply entering values such as the distance between grips, the crosshead automatically moves to the precise position. It also stops automatically when the lower limit of the jig-to-jig distance is reached, preventing collisions and ensuring operator safety.
 Multi-table
The AGS-V is equipped with a multi-table to enhance testing efficiency. The multi-table allows tools and specimens to be kept within easy reach. Its raised edges help prevent round objects from rolling off.
Protection Cover
The AGS-V can be equipped with an anti-scattering cover to enhance safety. It features a user-friendly vertical sliding mechanism for easy operation. An interlock system is included; if a test is initiated while the anti-scattering cover is open, an alert will be displayed to protect the operator.
